chennai.name: Chennai
chennai.crimeDataNote: Calibrated synthetic data (Phase 1) matched to a citywide annual-crime-count target; see README_phase1.md and README_phase3.md for the full methodology and honest limitations.
chennai.boundaryNote: Rectangle approximation of the Phase 1 analysis grid's extent, used for point-in-polygon city detection (not a distance-from-center check). This is NOT an official administrative boundary polygon -- swap in a real Greater Chennai Corporation boundary GeoJSON here for production use.

coimbatore.name: Coimbatore
coimbatore.crimeDataNote: Zone-level aggregate estimate: a flat citywide baseline from NCRB's CII-2017 report (Coimbatore ranked among the lowest of 19 large Indian cities for violent crime, 7.9/lakh) combined with real distance to the nearest actual police station. There is NO trained per-cell crime-prediction model for Coimbatore yet -- see README_coimbatore.md.
coimbatore.boundaryNote: Rectangle approximation of Coimbatore Corporation's extent, used for point-in-polygon city detection (not a distance-from-center check). This is NOT an official administrative boundary polygon -- swap in a real Coimbatore Corporation boundary GeoJSON here for production use.
